title: Abington Art Center

services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: Abington Art Center invites you to celebrate your milestone in style. Surrounded by contemporary art and natural beauty, the venue blends timeless elegance with creative charm. By celebrating with us, you support a vibrant non-profit dedicated to the arts and community building. Make your event unforgettable in a setting rich with history, artistry, and beautiful views. Wander through our expansive Sculpture Park and Nature Trail-an unforgettable backdrop for wedding portraits and guest strolls. services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Each summer we welcome area youth from age 4 to 16 for summer camp classes! Information for our Summer 2026 Camp Season will be available the first week of February, with Registration opening on February 10, 2026. This summer we will offer morning camps for ages 4-6, 7-9 and 9-12 as well as afternoon camps for ages 7-9, 9-12 and 13-16. Camps will begin the week of June 22nd and run through August 28th! Camps are booked weekly with some Ceramics Camps running for 2 weeks! This summer we will offer general visual arts camps, jewelry, ceramics, comics & Illustration, printmaking, painting and theater. blurb: Abington Art Center is a community center focused on music, drawing, painting, oil, ceramics, metals, sewing, embroidery, pottery, and jewelry classes. It is an outdoor free concert venue, with theater, dance, jazz, and live music on stage.
